narrative.overview: One dominant answer, a plain-language interpretation, then detail on demand. Shared hierarchy and semantic color connect every app destination.

rules.name: Contrast on answer surfaces
rules.body: Use answer-specific text and gain/loss tokens on dark financial answer surfaces.

dos: Preserve graphs and the Sankey diagram.
Keep account totals visible while groups are collapsed.
Verify both themes at supported device widths.
donts: Do not use dark green text on dark green surfaces.
Do not fabricate provider history or performance.
Do not put every supporting row in a separate card.
